name: clearscroll
description: Local-first Chrome extension that blurs content about topics you choose, using an on-device Rust/WebAssembly sentence encoder.

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ext
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:rust
scripts.release:prepare: npm run check && node scripts/assemble-production.mjs build/production-assembly && CLEARSCROLL_DIST=$PWD/build/production-assembly/a npm run test:e2e:text && npm run test:dom && CLEARSCROLL_DIST=$PWD/build/production-assembly/a npm run verify:privacy && CLEARSCROLL_DIST=$PWD/build/production-assembly/a npm run verify:privacy:feedback
scripts.test:e2e:text: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/e2e/a11y.test.ts tests/e2e/card-removal.test.ts tests/e2e/extension.test.ts tests/e2e/feedback.test.ts tests/e2e/text-boundaries.test.ts tests/e2e/topic-exclusions.test.ts tests/e2e/production.test.ts
